source.licence: Our own model fitted to the maker's data sheet (D-163): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.vceo: Mullard OC75 data sheet (Mullard Technical Handbook Vol. 4 Part III, Nov 1968: OC75 of March 1959, pages D1-D4 and C1-C11), page D1: limiting values, grounded emitter: Vc max. (d.c.) -20 V (base-ground impedance < 500 Ω or Vbe > 500 mV reverse)
rating_sources.ic: Mullard OC75 data sheet (Mullard Technical Handbook Vol. 4 Part III, Nov 1968: OC75 of March 1959, pages D1-D4 and C1-C11), page D1: limiting values: Ic max. 10 mA (averaged over 20 ms; 50 mA peak)

package.name: SO-2 glass (EBC)
package.source: Mullard OC75 data sheet (Mullard Technical Handbook Vol. 4 Part III, Nov 1968: OC75 of March 1959, pages D1-D4 and C1-C11), page D4: outline and dimensions (V.A.S.C.A. SO-2/SB3-2): e, b, c in a line, the dot on the collector side

fit.sheet: Mullard OC75 data sheet (Mullard Technical Handbook Vol. 4 Part III, Nov 1968: OC75 of March 1959, pages D1-D4 and C1-C11)
fit.figure: page C6 transfer characteristic at Vc = -4.5 V (IB 0 to 13 µA) and its Average spread line (2.6 to 22 mA); page C1 IE against VBE at Vc = -4.5 V (both ranges); page D2 table (Ico, fα); page D3 h'22 (VAF); Cob from the transistor cross-reference book, page 242 (data/spec-sheets/Germanium_OC_crossref.pdf) (a maximum: neither maker's sheet gives a capacitance)
fit.method: see NOTES.md (germanium study): transfer, VBE-IE and Ico fitted together at Vc = -4.5 V, leakage included; RB 0 (no rbb' given). Fitted points within 6.6 % (IC at IB) and 1.9 mV (VBE); ICBO 4.71 µA. Curves read off the raster by pixel (.claude/skills/fit-model/worked/germanium/pix.py)
fit.note: Provisional: a germanium-study card, not in the library (the AC128 stands in, D-170).

datasheet.source: Mullard OC75 data sheet (Mullard Technical Handbook Vol. 4 Part III, Nov 1968: OC75 of March 1959, pages D1-D4 and C1-C11), page D2: characteristics at Tj = 25 °C, Ico (Vc = -4.5 V, Ie = 0): 4.5 av., 14 max µA; Philips OC75 data sheet (1958-60, pages 1-3 and A-N; kept as data/spec-sheets/OC75_Philips.pdf), page 2: -ICBO (-VCB = 4.5 V) = 4.5, < 12 µA (the tighter maximum)

validation.note: Fitted to the average; a measured unit's leakage replaces it (D-130)
